say:1:1430245201:1.text: Although we are all Essail, they are commoners and servants while we are nobles.
say:1:1430245201:1.source_cn: 可我们是贵族，而他们则是平民和仆从——艾塞勒亦有不同。
say:1:1430245201:1.male: Although we are all Essail, they are commoners and servants while we are nobles.
say:1:1430245201:1.female: Although we are all Essail, they are commoners and servants while we are nobles.

say:3:1430245202:1.text: Nobles are noble. Servants are lowly.
say:3:1430245202:1.male: Nobles are noble. Servants are lowly.
say:3:1430245202:1.female: Nobles are noble. Servants are lowly.

say:4:1430245203:1.text: That's right, my child! These are the rules of Sal'thorin.
say:4:1430245203:1.source_cn: 没错，孩子！这就是萨洛克兰的规矩！
